_what: The owner's ART DIRECTION, in his own words, per species. SUBJECTIVE BY DESIGN.
_why: These are preferences about composition and specimen quality, not botany and not safety. They are kept apart from the briefs for exactly that reason: a brief says which structures must be VISIBLE for the plant to be identifiable, and failing one is a hard failure; a directive here says which of several identifiable photographs belongs on a card, and failing one is a soft note that blocks nothing. The two were briefly conflated and the result was a 0.17-fill specimen rejected for being small while two strips of background forest passed.
_how: The text is injected into the vision rubric as ART DIRECTION and judged as its own axis, separately from cropping and segmentation. Nothing here is a pixel threshold, and nothing here may become one without a reproducible failure to point at.
shared: One coherent specimen, not a colony and not a habitat scene.
Always touches the bottom edge of the art window; the other three edges are optional.
Do not force a bottom crop if the photograph does not contain enough stem to support it naturally.

matricaria_chamomilla.want: The flower face toward the camera so the large yellow centre reads, with stems and feathery foliage attached.
matricaria_chamomilla.avoid: A bloom facing away from the camera; a flower head with its stems cut off.
matricaria_chamomilla.owner: Keep Chamomile 650137635 as my preferred candidate.

taraxacum_officinale.want: A balanced specimen showing flowers, stems and recognizable toothed foliage together.
taraxacum_officinale.avoid: One oversized bloom filling the frame with no stem or leaf context.
taraxacum_officinale.owner: Dandelion: search for a more balanced specimen showing flowers, stems and recognizable foliage, rather than one oversized bloom.

verbascum_thapsus.want: A full, dense flowering spike with substantial woolly basal foliage.
verbascum_thapsus.avoid: A thin or sparse spike; a small specimen in a large frame; a spike clipped at the top.
verbascum_thapsus.owner: Mullein: the new spike is no longer clipped, but it is too thin and small. Find a fuller flowering spike with substantial foliage.

sambucus_canadensis.want: A healthy-looking fruiting specimen: dark berries on a visible cyme, with branching stems and intact leaves.
sambucus_canadensis.avoid: Turned or yellowed foliage; a stripped cyme; berry fragments with no supporting branch.
sambucus_canadensis.owner: Elderberry: preserve my rejection and continue searching for a healthy-looking fruiting specimen with dark berries, branching stems and leaves.

pinus_strobus.want: A recognizable, attractive BRANCH showing distinct needle clusters (fascicles).
pinus_strobus.avoid: A whole-tree habit shot; a stand of trees; a distant canopy where individual needles cannot be read.
pinus_strobus.owner: Pine: reject the whole-tree composition for this card. Search for a recognizable, attractive branch showing distinct needle clusters.
